definitions.explanation: The opening in a lock into which a key is inserted. Also used of the small hole one can peer through in an old-fashioned door lock.

examples.japanese: {鍵穴|かぎあな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: To insert the key into the keyhole.

examples.japanese: {鍵穴|かぎあな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れていて→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦{開|あ}かない→開く：00689_aku⟧。
examples.english: The keyhole is broken, so it won't open.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}くて→暗い：00647_kurai⟧{鍵穴|かぎあな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{照|て}らした→照らす：04669_terasu⟧。
examples.english: It was too dark to see the keyhole, so I lit it up with my phone's flashlight.
